title: PhishingUrlFeatureSchema
description: Defines the 17 exact numeric features used for phishing URL ML training and inference.

features.name: url_length
features.description: Total character length of the URL.

features.name: query_length
features.description: Character length of the query parameters string.

features.name: number_of_dots
features.description: Total count of dot '.' characters in the full URL.

features.name: number_of_hyphens
features.description: Total count of hyphen '-' characters in the full URL.

features.name: number_of_digits
features.description: Total count of numeric digit characters in the full URL.

features.name: number_of_special_characters
features.description: Count of special characters (=, &, %, ?, _, ~, #, @) in the full URL.

features.name: number_of_subdomains
features.description: Number of subdomain labels before the registered domain.

features.name: has_ip_address
features.description: 1 if hostname is an IPv4 or IPv6 address, 0 otherwise.

features.name: has_at_symbol
features.description: 1 if '@' character appears in the URL, 0 otherwise.

features.name: has_shortener
features.description: 1 if domain matches a known URL shortener service, 0 otherwise.

features.name: redirect_count
features.description: Number of redirect hops followed during resolution.

features.name: domain_changed
features.description: 1 if initial domain differs from final redirect domain, 0 otherwise.

features.name: https_downgrade
features.description: 1 if an HTTPS link redirected to an unencrypted HTTP link, 0 otherwise.
